primary: Official sum(virtual_time_us)/1e6/sum(jammer_count), show completion separately; incomplete prefixes do not establish efficiency
interval: 10000 independent case bootstrap replicates per group, 95% percentile interval
test: Exact swap of two treatment labels within the 10 randomized order blocks; 1024 assignments; Holm over 14 contrasts
secondary: Sensitivity only: total_s ~ variant + source_count (+ directional_count for Q4), OLS HC3 t intervals; normalize to pooled source_count; Holm over 14
caveat: Each official case is unique. Temporal randomized blocks do not create matched scene pairs. Small sample and geometry remain unobserved.
